titulo_seo: Motorsport rights sales — La Virage Club
descripcion_seo: We sell the sponsorship, merchandising, tickets and hospitality of rallies, circuits, clubs, drivers and teams. We work on results, for an agreed percentage of what we sell.

secciones.titulo: What your rally is worth, sold.
secciones.texto: SPONSORSHIP, MERCHANDISING, TICKETS, HOSPITALITY AND EVERYTHING ELSE. FOR ORGANISERS, DRIVERS AND TEAMS. ON RESULTS, FOR AN AGREED PERCENTAGE.

secciones.titulo:
Everything your race generates
that someone would pay
to be part of.
secciones.cuerpo:
The name on the poster. The car door. The marquee next to the service park. The T-shirt fans take home. Saturday night's dinner. All of it has a price, and it's hardly ever sold in full.

If you run a rally, a circuit meeting or a club event, those rights are yours. If you race, so are yours: your car, your race suit, your season and your social channels. Our job is to sell them.

secciones.subtitulo: ONE BY ONE · PER EVENT OR PER SEASON

items.texto: The brand in the event name, on a stage, on the podium, on the car or on the race suit. For one weekend or the whole season.
What fans take home: t-shirts, caps, patches, stickers. Design, production and sales at the event.
Saturday's party, the official dinner, the prize-giving. What happens off the stages can have a ticket too.
A well-chosen spot, a good table and good company for a brand's guests. Formula 1 hospitality, with rally dust.
Any asset from the weekend that can be sold: spaces, content, experiences, access. If it's worth something, we'll find a buyer.

secciones.titulo:
On results, for an
agreed percentage.

items.titulo: A share of what we sell
items.texto: To start with, we work on results: we agree with you a percentage of whatever we sell, and we get paid when you do.
The percentage is agreed with you up front and depends on what needs selling and the work behind it. No small print.

secciones.titulo:
Rallying from the inside.
Sold like F1.

items.titulo: We know rallying from the inside
items.texto: We know how a race weekend comes together, what an organiser needs and what keeps a driver up at night. We speak the language of the service park.

items.titulo: We treat it as a premium product
items.texto: A rally isn't a lesser event. We sell it with Formula 1's playbook: clear packages, properly presented, and an experience the brand wants to come back to.
Whatever we sell, we build ourselves. The brand isn't buying a promise: it's buying something we'll make happen on race weekend.

secciones.subtitulo: TELL US WHAT YOU'VE GOT AND WE'LL TELL YOU WHAT CAN BE SOLD

columnas.texto: Rally, circuit or club. Tell us which event, the dates and what you're selling today, if anything.

columnas.titulo: I race or run a team
columnas.texto: Tell us the championship, the calendar and what space you've got free on the car, the race suit and your channels.
